text: Frozen seven synthetic cases, same-objective disjoint ranked-prefix comparator, raw L1 constraints, 5-second/100000-node limits, independent exhaustive optima and known infeasibility. Both knapsack comparisons require 270 vs ranked100; ties and small-set controls must not lose. Freeze hashes and oracle results in docs/evidence/designer-v1/, optimizer_exists=false. Initial harness failure was R partial-name matching, fixed without changing fixtures or tolerances before freeze.
